title: Remote Agent incorrectly requires origin/main base ref
details:
- **What happened:** Three remote read-only Agent launches failed with `Failed to resolve base branch "origin/main": git rev-parse failed`; expected remote analysis to use current HEAD or explicitly supplied baseline without requiring origin/main.
- **What the user said:** “开始并行开发吧”
- **Repro:** In a repository where `refs/remotes/origin/main` intentionally does not exist, call Agent with `isolation: "remote"` from a non-main feature branch.
- **Evidence:** Repository baseline `fc64aebb729826960d2ca4e0dfcc1538c9c027b0`; required working branch `eam-01-10-lifecycle-approval`; all three launches failed on 2026-09-10.
